plans.idea: Classic landscape split: the bottle fills a large left half, while a tight left-aligned right column stacks logo, a big 'Glow' headline and the CTA on one shared edge, so there's no dead space between them.
Left-to-right banner triptych: brand and headline on the left, the product centred as the focal anchor, and the CTA on the right, so the eye moves brand → product → action.
Text-first editorial layout: the logo sits top-left, a large headline and CTA are grouped in a left column below it, and the bottle fills the right half as a large product shot.
